items.name: European Sustainability Reporting Standards (CSRD)
items.body: European Commission, with technical advice from EFRAG
items.covers: ESRS Set 1 (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2023/2772) and the simplified ESRS adopted as a delegated act on 3 July 2026
items.headline: The original ESRS (Official Journal, 22 Dec 2023) remain the text in force. On 3 Jul 2026 the Commission published delegated acts for simplified ESRS and a voluntary standard and sent them to Parliament and Council. If not rejected they enter into force on publication in the Official Journal; the simplified ESRS apply to financial years beginning on or after 1 Jan 2027, with early adoption for 2026 once in force. Whether they have entered into force was not checked.

items.name: EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism
items.covers: Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as simplified by Regulation (EU) 2025/2083; implementing acts on methods, default values, benchmarks and certificate prices
items.headline: The definitive regime applies from 1 Jan 2026. Quarterly certificate prices for 2026: Q1 EUR 75.36, Q2 EUR 75.28, Q3 EUR 82.32; Q4 is due 4 Jan 2027. Certificates are bought on the common central platform from February 2027 and priced weekly from 2027. Certificates due are reduced by free allocation, which the CBAM factor phases out: 97.5% in 2026 to none from 2034.

key_dates.event: Transitional (reporting-only) period starts
Definitive regime applies

Q2 2026 certificate price published: EUR 75.28

Q3 2026 certificate price published: EUR 82.32

key_values.cbam_factor_source: Directive 2003/87/EC Art. 10a(1a) (consolidated 1 Mar 2024), read on EUR-Lex; Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2620 applies it to the free-allocation adjustment

engine.holds: Certificate share = 1 minus the CBAM factor (2.5% in 2026 to 100% from 2034); 2026 price = mean of the three published quarters
engine.note: Corrected on 6 Nov 2026: climate/cbam.py had assumed 100% from 2026 and a EUR 60 price, which overstated the 2026 bill about forty-fold. Still not loaded: the Commission's default values (2025/2621, corrected by 2026/1740) and the free-allocation benchmarks (2025/2620); embedded intensities remain screening proxies. Prices from 2027 are a scenario path.
